summary: Dark backgrounds (flat or gradient), thin white border at 20% opacity, OR image-bg with dark-faded overlay + light/accent text. Headings ALL CAPS.

colors.notes: Accent colours used 'where needed' — i.e. for CTAs, highlights, key words. Background MUST be one of the two dark colours (flat or gradient between them). The two dark colours #000000 and #191919 are INTERCHANGEABLE within either treatment type — pick either, they do not have layout-specific meaning.

gradients.rule: Always top-to-bottom (or bottom-to-top). Horizontal/diagonal gradients are off-bible.
gradients.applies_to: type_b overlay fade; type_a background gradient between the two dark colours

accent_frequency_rule.rule: Single accent colour per image is the default. Two accents only when one is structural (e.g. CTA) and the other is highlighting (e.g. number or stat). Never three or more accent colours in one image.
accent_frequency_rule.answered_2026_07_29: Single unless absolutely required for two, never more than two

borders.stroke_width_px_relative: thin (visual ratio ~1px per 1080px image, i.e. ~0.1% of width)
borders.rule: RECOMMENDED on type_a (dark bg) layouts. Strongly preferred on type_b (image bg) layouts. May be omitted only if focal contrast with white text/border is already achieved.

type_a.name: flat_or_gradient_dark_background
type_a.border: thin white at 20% opacity, around image edge
type_a.text: white or accent colour over dark background

type_b.name: image_with_dark_fade_overlay
type_b.overlay: gradient of dark colour faded over image
type_b.text: light or accent colour above overlay

headings.use: page titles, section titles, hero text

compliance_rules: Headings MUST be Avenir Next Heavy Italic
Body MUST be Avenir Next Italic

compliance_score.threshold_notes: Start at 0.70 for the v0.1 rollout. If too noisy (too many false-positive failures on legit brand assets), tighten to 0.80. If too strict (legit assets failing), loosen to 0.65. Re-tune after first 100 new dissections.
compliance_score.answered_2026_07_29: Start at 0.70, can tighten up later if needed

voice_refs.note: Voice bible governs copy; this file governs visuals.

resolved_questions_2026_07_29.3_dark_colours_interchangeable: Yes — #000000 and #191919 are interchangeable; pick either per image, no layout-specific meaning.
resolved_questions_2026_07_29.4_gradient_direction: Always vertical (top-to-bottom or bottom-to-top). No horizontal/diagonal.
resolved_questions_2026_07_29.5_accent_frequency_rule: Single accent per image is default. Two only when one is structural (CTA) + one is highlight (stat/number). Never more than two.
